title: Measurement of Food Consumption and Body Weight in Mice
author: Henri Brunengraber
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.yeqftdw

steps.title: Mark mice and record baseline weight
steps.instruction: Mark each mouse by ear notches, then weigh each mouse and record its body weight.

steps.title: Place mice and weigh initial food
steps.instruction: At 9:00 AM place the mice (2–3 per clean cage to avoid stress) into a clean cage, then weigh the amount of food placed in the cage and record this weight.

substeps.instruction: Place mice (2–3 per clean cage) at 9:00 AM
Weigh the amount of food in the cage and record the weight

steps.title: Weigh mice and food next day
steps.instruction: At 9:00 AM the following day, weigh each mouse and the remaining food in the cage, recording all measurements.

substeps.instruction: At 9:00 AM next day, weigh each mouse and record its weight
Weigh the remaining food in the cage and record its weight

steps.title: Calculate daily food intake
steps.instruction: Subtract the day 3 food weight from the day 2 food weight, then divide the result by the total weight of the mice in the cage.

substeps.instruction: Subtract day 3 food weight from day 2 food weight
Divide the difference by the total mouse weight in the cage

steps.title: Represent data as averages
steps.instruction: Express the calculated intake as an average over the entire diet study or as a weekly average over time.
